title: Rating configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.RatingAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

IsEdit.description: Lets the user change the rating; when false it is read-only.

RatingValue.description: Current rating; a fractional part from 0.3 to 0.7 renders a half-filled item, below rounds down, above rounds up.

Size.description: Size modifier appended as the rating-<Size> class (empty for the default size).

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
